champion.name: Industry Diffusion + Weekly Low-MAX
champion.clock: exact frozen weekly decision close and next-legal-open entry
champion.holding: exact frozen 20-session lifecycle and QD-010 execution

feature_history.schedule: every fifth PIT trading session stepped backward from the first frozen champion signal and then the exact frozen champion signal dates
feature_history.threshold_history: strictly earlier scheduled observations only; current and future observations excluded
feature_history.state_method: expanding prior-history terciles; LOW <= prior q1, MEDIUM between prior q1 and q2, HIGH > prior q2

ABSOLUTE_MARKET_STATE.definition: compound the daily cross-sectional median PIT-valid stock step return over the 20 completed sessions ending at the decision close

CROSS_SECTIONAL_DISPERSION.definition: P90 minus P10 of PIT-valid individual-stock compounded returns over the same 20 completed sessions ending at the decision close

SYNCHRONIZATION.definition: absolute sign imbalance abs(2 * fraction of PIT-valid stock 20-session returns above zero - 1)

INDUSTRY_PERSISTENCE.definition: Spearman correlation of PIT-industry 20-session return ranks between the current and immediately preceding scheduled weekly observation

outcomes.cohort_payoff: mean frozen trade final_net_return by signal date
outcomes.relative_selection: cohort payoff minus subsequent broad and selected-industry 20-session proxies
outcomes.construction_use: outcomes are joined only after every feature and causal state is frozen

prohibited: Positive Industry Breadth rescue or active use
champion modification, exposure scaling, admission veto, filter, hedge, exit, or hypothetical improved return
Top-N, holding, Low-MAX, Industry Diffusion, cost, clock, or execution change
regression, clustering, classifier, tree, model, feature zoo, threshold search, or return-maximizing combination
more than the three frozen two-dimensional maps or any three/four-dimensional map
OOS, independent-validation, live, or production claim
